steps.title: Loosen the rear screws
lines: Use a Phillips PH00 screwdriver to loosen the four screws along the top of the back cover.

All screws in this device are [guide|93991|JIS screws|stepid=176809|new_window=true]. Official [product|IF145-006|iFixit PH000-PH1 Phillips screwdrivers|new_window=true] are designed to be compatible with JIS screws, so they are safe to use. Using a screwdriver other than an official iFixit screwdriver or a JIS screwdriver may result in [guide|13213|stripped screws|new_window=true].
The screws are held in place by locking washers, and will not come out of the back cover.

steps.title: Remove the rear cover
lines: Hold the device in one hand and turn it over.
Grab the top edge of the back cover with your opposite hand so that the cover does not fall back into place.
Flip the 3DS over again so that the back cover is facing up.
Pull the back cover up and away from the rest of the device to remove it.
